Subject: MSA alignment & pilot demo — calendar options

Hi Caroline —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. To keep the procurement runway moving, can we lock in a 60-minute block next week for two things: (1) a quick walkthrough of the redline items in the MSA (we reviewed high-level already) and (2) a short pilot demo so your platform/ops team can see Dedicated capacity behavior with a sample workload?

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue 2026-07-21 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-07-22 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2026-07-23 11:00–12:00

If none of those work, please share up to three windows that do. On our side I’ll have Marissa (legal) on the redline items and Laura (CS) + Rafael (solutions) on the demo and pilot scope. I attached the latest redline PDF and a one-slide pilot scope to this thread for your reference.

Attachments: redwood_msa_v2_redlines.pdf, pilot_scope_slide_deck.pptx

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

From: Caroline Hsu <caroline@silverline.io>

Cc: Tom Weller <tweller@silverline.io>, procurements@silverline.io
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA alignment & pilot demo — calendar options

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the follow-up. We can do a combined session — that will help our legal and ops teams see the live behavior while we talk terms. Quick notes on attendees: procurement (procurements@silverline.io), myself, and Tom Weller (security lead). Marissa/Laura/Rafael on your side sounds perfect.

From our calendar the best fits are:
- Wed 2026-07-22 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu 2026-07-23 11:00–12:00 PT

A couple of things we want to cover on the MSA side so Marissa is prepared:
- Data residency and audit log retention language (Section 4.2)
- Subprocessor list + SOC2 evidence cadence
- Termination assistance and escrow for KV cache exports

Also, Tom will want to see the demo run with a 90k token sequence to understand caching/latency behavior — if your demo needs a specific model or tokens let us know.

We don’t need more than one hour, and we can follow with a short procurement-only call if there are remaining redlines to settle.

Best —
Caroline
Caroline Hsu
Director of Procurement, Silverline Health
caroline@silverline.io

Subject: Re: MSA alignment & pilot demo — calendar options

Caroline —

Thanks, Wed 2026-07-22 14:00 PT is great; I’m booking the hour. Agenda (proposed, 60m):
- 0–15m: introductions + procurement checklist (Caroline / proc team)
- 15–35m: MSA redline walkthrough (Marissa + Caroline) — focus on Sections 4.2, subprocessors, and termination assistance
- 35–55m: Pilot demo (Laura + Rafael) — we’ll run a 90k token-ish demo with caching enabled and show latency profile and KV export mechanics
- 55–60m: next steps / procurement-only follow-up if needed

Marissa — can you confirm if you want us to share a short summary of each redline (2–3 bullets) ahead of the call? I can draft and send EOD today.

Laura/Rafael — we’ll need the demo environment to exercise the 90k token window and a small seeded prompt set; Rafael can you confirm the demo runtime (model variant + quantization) you prefer?

Caroline, I’ll send a calendar invite with a GoToMeeting link and attach the redline summary + pilot runbook.

— Vivek
